comment: Tattlestone read-only command policy, shared by the app (src/shared/command-policy.json, read by src/shared/commandPolicy.ts) and the UNO Q bridge (firmware/uno-q-bridge/command_policy.json, an identical copy; tests in both fail if they differ). Allowlist: anything not listed here is refused.

atDenyPrefixes.ATCAF0: CAN auto-formatting off: the first byte becomes the PCI length, so the service check stops working
atDenyPrefixes.ATPP: programmable parameters change the adapter's power-on defaults
atDenyPrefixes.ATWM: the wakeup message is sent to the vehicle periodically and can carry any bytes
atDenyPrefixes.ATFCSD: custom flow-control data puts arbitrary bytes on the bus
